create.modeQuickDesc: A few essentials — we handle the rest.
create.modeAdvancedDesc: Customize every detail of the story.
create.storyIdeaIntro: Freely describe the story you'd like to create. You can share something that happened today, a lesson you want to pass on, a specific adventure, a theme, or any other idea.
create.storyIdeaPlaceholder: E.g. My son is afraid of the dark, I'd love a story that helps him overcome that fear with courage and humor…
create.storyIdeaOptional: Optional — if you leave this blank, we'll craft a beautiful story based on your choices above.
create.storyIdeaExample1: My son is afraid of the dark — I'd love a story that helps him overcome that fear.
create.storyIdeaExample2: My daughter had a wonderful day at the beach today — I'd love to turn that into a magical adventure.
create.storyIdeaExample3: I want to teach my child the basics of money and saving.
create.storyIdeaExample4: I want a story where my child becomes an explorer discovering Japan.
